'''Heffa Schücking''' (born 1959) is a German environmentalist. She was awarded the [[Goldman Environmental Prize]] in 1994,<ref name="goldman">Goldman Environmental Prize: [http://www.goldmanprize.org/node/161 Heffa Schuecking] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120918204232/http://www.goldmanprize.org/1994/europe |date=18 September 2012 }} (Retrieved on November 27, 2007)</ref> for her works to protect the [[rainforest]]s.

Today, she mainly works for the NGO urgewald on campaigns to prevent banks and the financial industry from making harmful investments such as cluster ammunition, [[coal mining]] or the nuclear industry.
